_meta._comment: Presets for scripts/generate_video_clip.py (fal.ai image-to-video). Each preset upgrades a trailer hero shot from procedural/hand-drawn cel motion to a real AI clip written to its 'out' path; scripts/build_trailer.py auto-picks up trailer/clips/<shot_id>.mp4 and falls back to procedural when absent. SCHEMA: presets are keyed by a short name (the --preset value). Each preset = { model?, prompt, negative_prompt?, duration (s), aspect_ratio?, start_image, end_image?, out }. 'start_image' is the first video frame (image_url); optional 'end_image' is the tail frame (tail_image_url) for Kling start+end interpolation, so keyframe-1 morphs into keyframe-3. Omit 'end_image' (or pass --no-end-image) for subtle single-frame motion. 'model' falls back to _meta.default_model; image field names come from _meta.image_key / tail_image_key. Prompts follow the cel/Hakuoki look in docs/cg-style-prompt-block.md and trailer/style/style-bible.md (Kaoru wears YELLOW/GOLD robes, never green). Model ids on fal.ai change over time; override with --model or edit default_model (browse https://fal.ai/models).

toa_fan.prompt: 2D anime cel-shaded otome illustration, Hakuoki style, painterly cel shading with clean colored linework: a cheerful white-haired woman with grey eyes in a black kosode with gold crane obi raises a folding fan and snaps it open across the lower half of her face, chin lifting and bright eyes rising to camera; gentle hair and sleeve movement, warm lantern backlight, fine rain bokeh behind, illustrated lantern glow not lens flare, smooth on-twos hand-drawn animation, no morphing artifacts
toa_fan.negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, live action, CGI, lens flare, extra fingers, malformed hands, fused fingers, warping face, flicker, furisode long swinging sleeves, oni mask, demon mask, western clothing, watermark, text, logo
